title: A notebook that worked, made into a model that keeps its method and none of its case
exercises: The skill that derives a model: understanding the notebook, asking the level of generality, separating the method from the circumstance, rewriting it into a new notebook, declaring its parameters and creating its first version with the author's approval.
rubric: Before writing anything, the executor says what method the notebook applies and asks how general the model should be, offering choices from the closest to the source to the broadest.
It follows the objective the person chose — evaluating any source code — and neither keeps it to one mobile application nor broadens it further.

It lists what is specific to the case (the analyst, the organization, the application, its version, the laboratory, the people named) and proposes to remove, generalize or turn into a parameter each one, asking before deciding.
The model is a new notebook: the source notebook is left exactly as it was.
Guidance, folder descriptions and templates are rewritten for evaluating any source code, not merely with names replaced by parameters.
Examples are written anew for the model; no real finding of the source is copied without the person asking.
It declares the parameters the person agreed to, each with a description, an example, a type and whether it is required, and creates the first version only after the person approves the review.

variants.request: Esse meu caderno da avaliação do Carteira Serpro funcionou muito bem. Queria transformar ele numa base que outras pessoas possam copiar para avaliar outros sistemas. Pode me ajudar?
